name: Whello Sticky Chat Button
author: Whello Indonesia

sections.description:
Whello Sticky Chat Button adds a customizable WhatsApp button to your website that stays visible as users scroll, making it easy for them to contact you directly through WhatsApp.

Key Features

  • Fully Customizable: Change colors, text, position, and appearance
  • Flexible Display Options: Show on desktop, mobile, or both
  • Page Visibility Control: Display on all pages or exclude specific ones
  • Custom Link Support: Use standard WhatsApp API or custom link (e.g., from third-party services)
  • Pre-filled Message: Set a default message to make it easier for visitors to start a conversation
  • Modern Design: Clean, responsive design that works on all devices
  • Easy to Configure: Simple admin interface with live preview
  • Lightweight: Optimized code that won’t slow down your website

Use Cases

  • Customer support for e-commerce stores
  • Quick contact option for service businesses
  • Lead generation for consultants and professionals
  • Instant communication channel for any website

sections.installation:
1. Upload the whello-sticky-chat-button folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘WA Button’ in your admin menu to configure the settings
  4. Enter your WhatsApp number and customize the appearance
  5. Save your settings and the button will appear on your site
sections.faq:
What format should I use for the phone number?

Enter your phone number with the country code but without any symbols or spaces. For example: 6281234567890

Can I customize where the button appears?

Yes, you can choose to display the button on all pages or exclude specific pages.

Does this plugin work on mobile devices?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and works on both desktop and mobile devices. You can also choose to show/hide the button on specific device types.

Can I use a custom link instead of the default WhatsApp link?

Yes, you can choose between the default WhatsApp API link or use a custom link, which is useful if you’re using a third-party service like Whello WA Rotator.

Can I change the button colors and style?

Yes, you can customize the button color, text color, icon color, border radius, and more from the settings page.

Is this plugin compatible with other WhatsApp plugins?

Yes, this plugin works independently and should not conflict with other WhatsApp plugins.
